acceptanceCriteria: the owner decides whether ARTIFACT-V0-008 covers every workflow (with a declared per-job exception list) or stays ci.yml-only; the decision is recorded
if widened: the check covers all .github/workflows/*.yml, the nightly-failure-signal exception is declared, and a mutation (workflow-level issues: write) fails it
body: Residual from the V1-1114 lane (PR #954). The new nightly-failure-signal job in .github/workflows/release-gates.yml is the only job holding issues: write; its permissions are pinned by TestSOPV0013WorkflowBinding, but script/check-ci-least-privilege.sh (ARTIFACT-V0-008) covers ci.yml only, so release-gates.yml and other workflows have no general least-privilege check. Widening the check amends accepted ARTIFACT-V0-008, so it needs an owner decision.
title: Question: extend the CI least-privilege check (ARTIFACT-V0-008) beyond ci.yml to release-gates.yml with a per-job exception list?
